guideControls.caption: Use the arrow keys or tap the trail to walk. Tap an object to approach it, or press E when you are close.

guideBoard.caption: Pick up one board at the rack. Carry it to its matching socket. Set it in place, then go back for the next board.

guideRope.caption: Hook the rope on the anchor. Walk to the second cleat, then pull it tight.

guideFord.caption: Turn the near flag northwest and the far flag southeast. Plant them by the white stones. Then carry the pack to the loading spot.

guideEvidence.caption: Inspect both clues for your route. Choose a route, then select the observations that support it.

guideElementary.caption: Use the word bank or type your own words. Finish a short sentence that tells the ranger what you saw.

guideMiddle.caption: Write a short recommendation. Give one specific detail that you found at the scene.
